variable_length_layout.outer_capture_policy: retain every capture column by coordinated legal edge growth while minimizing helix-to-helix edge stagger (prefer <=10/11 bp; hard limit 21 bp)
variable_length_layout.terminal_capture_core_exception: final capture column only; first prefer a 32--48-nt Seed core by legal edge extension that does not increase scaffold count; the resulting Z1/Z3 length may not exceed requested +11 bp; if legal extension is exhausted, the target/nick-to-physical-edge path may be >=13 nt without a staple crossover or >=21 nt when that exact path contains a staple crossover
